query: 2026 private equity backed precision machining platform completes add-on acquisition

results.summary: BTX Precision, a 2024 L Squared Capital-backed startup, completed an add-on acquisition of Maitland Engineering (South Bend, IN) to expand its North American precision-component footprint. Maitland will operate as a standalone unit within BTX, maintaining its sites and leadership. The deal enhances BTX’s scale, production capabilities, and customer base, enabling end-to-end, high-volume micro‑precision machining and a broader medical device manufacturing offering under one brand. This aligns with a broader PE‑driven consolidation trend in the precision‑components sector, aiming to reduce lead times and costs through integrated tooling and a digital‑manufacturing platform.

results.title: GCM Acquires Kettmann Machining To Expand MedTech Manufacturing Capabilities
results.summary: GCM, backed by Avista Healthcare Partners, has completed the add-on acquisition of Kettmann Machining to expand its MedTech manufacturing capabilities. The deal adds a 40,000-square-foot facility in San Jose, enhancing capacity for high-precision plastic and metal parts and strengthening GCM’s ability to serve MedTech OEMs. Kettmann, with four decades of precision machining experience, complements GCM’s existing footprint (Union City, plus Chicago, Atlanta, Wilmington) and supports their strategy of scale and deeper technical expertise in medical device manufacturing. Financial terms were not disclosed.

results.title: Threadlock Precision (Backed by The D. E. Shaw Group) Acquires R&S Machining | PrivSource
results.summary: Threadlock Precision, a private equity-backed precision manufacturing platform led by The D. E. Shaw Group, completed an add-on acquisition in 2026 by acquiring R&S Machining, a St. Louis-based CNC precision shop founded in 1992. The deal expands Threadlock’s large-format machining, assembly, and engineering capabilities, boosting capacity and capabilities within its aerospace and defense-focused manufacturing network. This follows Threadlock’s pattern of strategic add-ons to broaden geographic reach and technical breadth for aerospace/defense programs.

results.title: LFM Capital Portfolio Company J&E Precision Tool Acquires Alloy Specialties and Beranek | PrivSource
results.summary:
Summary:

A 2021 private equity-backed precision machining platform completed two add-on acquisitions: J&E Precision Tool (an LFM Capital portfolio company) acquired Alloy Specialties Inc. (Manchester, CT) and Beranek Inc. (Torrance, CA). The deals expand J&E’s national footprint, precision machining capabilities, and aerospace/defense/space customer relationships. Financial terms were not disclosed. If you’re looking for 2026 equivalents, note this example shows a PE-backed platform expanding via add-ons to strengthen capabilities and reach in high-precision manufacturing.

results.title: Threadlock Precision (backed by The D. E. Shaw Group) Acquires J&F Machine | PrivSource
results.summary: Summary: In 2025, Threadlock Precision, a private equity-backed precision machining platform (backed by The D. E. Shaw Group), completed an add-on acquisition of J&F Machine, a Cypress, California CNC shop serving aerospace, defense, and commercial markets. This move expands Threadlock’s integrated network of precision manufacturers, bringing J&F’s capabilities, modernization, and growth capital into the platform as part of its strategy to scale through add-ons.
